description_en: Enables or disables SCIM-based user synchronization independently. When enabled, an initial full import is executed asynchronously. You can query the result by calling GetIdentityProviderSCIM. The SAML logon configuration is retained
description_zh: 独立启用或关闭 SCIM 用户同步。开启时异步执行首次全量导入，结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM 查询，保留 SAML 登录配置
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-identity-provider-scim --workspace-id ws-example --biz-body syncEnabled=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the destination workspace. The region of the request must be the same as the region of the destination workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. You can only update this parameter later by calling UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM. Determine the result based on the operationStatus field
fields.help_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断
fields.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: Submit business parameters as described in this operation. The body parameters of public APIs are mapped to backend wrappers by the gateway. Do not mix them with direct backend body wrappers
parameters.help_zh: 按本接口说明提交业务参数；公开 API 的 body 参数由网关映射到后端包装，不混用后端直连 body 包装
parameters.name: body

code.description_en: The business result code. If the call fails, handle the error based on the HTTP status code and the message
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The original fields and the meaning of the status field are retained. The new scimStatus field corresponds to the data.status field in the query operation. The operationStatus field retains the status of the most recent SCIM task
data.description_zh: 保留旧字段和 status 含义；新增 scimStatus 与查询接口 data.status 对应，operationStatus 保留最近 SCIM 任务状态

configuration.description_en: The actual upstream configuration. The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only by GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. The query returns the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The entity ID of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be non-empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. You cannot change the entity ID of an existing configuration. This ID is different from the local entity ID returned by the SP query
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The SSO logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual SSO logon status of AgentIdentity. Valid values: Enabled and Disabled. This value is not equivalent to the expected value of loginEnabled saved in AC
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

createdAt.description_en: The time when the record was created on the server
createdAt.description_zh: 服务端记录的创建时间

eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_en: The event subscription callback URL. CustomSSO returns an empty string. You must obtain the SCIM receiving URL by calling the SCIM query or preparation operation. The example shows a JSON empty string "". The actual value does not contain double quotation marks
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_zh: CustomSSO 返回空字符串；SCIM 接收地址通过 SCIM 查询或准备接口取得。示例以 JSON 空字符串 "" 展示，实际值不包含双引号
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.title_en: SAML 不使用厂商事件回调地址
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.title_zh: SAML 不使用厂商事件回调地址

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the identity provider. General CRUD operations support DingTalk, Feishu, and CustomSSO. SP queries support only CustomSSO. The SCIM path uses the CustomSSO shared pool
identityProviderType.description_zh: 通用 CRUD 支持 DingTalk、Feishu、CustomSSO；SP 查询仅支持 CustomSSO。SCIM 路径固定使用 CustomSSO 共享池

loginCallbackUrl.description_en: The logon callback URL. CustomSSO returns an empty string. You must obtain the ACS URL for SAML by calling the SP query operation. The example shows a JSON empty string "". The actual value does not contain double quotation marks
loginCallbackUrl.description_zh: CustomSSO 返回空字符串；SAML 的 ACS 地址应通过 SP 查询接口取得。示例以 JSON 空字符串 "" 展示，实际值不包含双引号
loginCallbackUrl.title_en: SAML 不使用厂商回调地址
loginCallbackUrl.title_zh: SAML 不使用厂商回调地址

loginEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether logon is enabled. Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. A valid SAML configuration must be saved before enabling logon. Disabling logon does not delete the configuration. If an asynchronous task fails, this expected value does not indicate that the configuration has taken effect upstream
loginEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；启用前须保存有效 SAML 配置。关闭不删除配置。异步失败时该期望值不代表上游已生效

metadata.description_en: The standard IdP metadata. Vendor parameters are used for DingTalk and Feishu. CustomSSO updates use the protocol and saml fields and do not accept this field. The return value does not contain vendor keys
metadata.description_zh: 厂商参数用于 DingTalk、Feishu；CustomSSO 更新使用 protocol、saml，不接受此字段。返回值不含厂商密钥

binding.description_en: The SAML binding URI in the historical metadata snapshot. For CustomSSO updates, use saml.bindingType
binding.description_zh: 历史 metadata 快照中的 SAML Binding URI；CustomSSO 更新请使用 saml.bindingType
binding.title_en: 规范化 SAML 绑定标识
binding.title_zh: 规范化 SAML 绑定标识

certificates.description_en: The certificate string in the historical metadata snapshot. To edit the configuration, use saml.x509Certificates and do not submit the old metadata
certificates.description_zh: 历史 metadata 快照中的证书串；编辑配置使用 saml.x509Certificates，不提交旧 metadata
certificates.title_en: 规范化 SAML 证书内容
certificates.title_zh: 规范化 SAML 证书内容

entityId.description_en: The entity ID of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be non-empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. You cannot change the entity ID of an existing configuration. This ID is different from the local entity ID returned by the SP query
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The SSO logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

oidc.description_en: 期望配置的安全摘要；不包含凭据。原 SAML 字段与含义保留
oidc.description_zh: 期望配置的安全摘要；不包含凭据。原 SAML 字段与含义保留

authorizationEndpoint.description_en: 手填模式必填的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写
authorizationEndpoint.description_zh: 手填模式必填的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写

clientAuthMethod.description_en: 默认 client_secret_post；none 必须开启 PKCE
clientAuthMethod.description_zh: 默认 client_secret_post；none 必须开启 PKCE

clientId.description_en: 外部 IdP 中注册的客户端标识，区别于 Matrix 客户端；配置后不支持原地更换
clientId.description_zh: 外部 IdP 中注册的客户端标识，区别于 Matrix 客户端；配置后不支持原地更换

discoveryEndpoint.description_en: 绝对 HTTPS Discovery 地址；与手填端点互斥
discoveryEndpoint.description_zh: 绝对 HTTPS Discovery 地址；与手填端点互斥

issuer.description_en: 外部 IdP 的绝对 HTTPS Issuer；配置后不支持原地更换
issuer.description_zh: 外部 IdP 的绝对 HTTPS Issuer；配置后不支持原地更换

jwksUri.description_en: 手填模式必填的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写
jwksUri.description_zh: 手填模式必填的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写

pkceRequired.description_en: 默认 true；无客户端认证时必须为 true
pkceRequired.description_zh: 默认 true；无客户端认证时必须为 true

scopes.description_en: 字符串数组，必须包含 openid；默认 openid、profile、email
scopes.description_zh: 字符串数组，必须包含 openid；默认 openid、profile、email

items.description_en: 单个非空 scope，不含空白字符
items.description_zh: 单个非空 scope，不含空白字符

ssoMappingClaim.description_en: ID Token 中用于与 SCIM externalId 匹配的 Claim 名。首次省略默认 sub；更新省略保留已保存值。Azure 可填 oid。非空且不含空白字符。查询 oidc 为保存值，oidcConfiguration 为上游实际值，可能为空
ssoMappingClaim.description_zh: ID Token 中用于与 SCIM externalId 匹配的 Claim 名。首次省略默认 sub；更新省略保留已保存值。Azure 可填 oid。非空且不含空白字符。查询 oidc 为保存值，oidcConfiguration 为上游实际值，可能为空

tokenEndpoint.description_en: 手填模式必填的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写
tokenEndpoint.description_zh: 手填模式必填的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写

userinfoEndpoint.description_en: 手填模式可选的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写
userinfoEndpoint.description_zh: 手填模式可选的绝对 HTTPS URL；Discovery 模式不填写

operationStatus.description_en: The original status of the most recent independent SCIM operation task. If no historical tasks exist, an empty string ("") is returned
operationStatus.description_zh: 最近一次独立 SCIM 操作任务的原始状态；没有历史任务时返回空字符串（""）
operationStatus.title_en: 最近一次 SCIM 操作状态
operationStatus.title_zh: 最近一次 SCIM 操作状态

protocol.description_en: The logon protocol. Only SAML is supported. This field may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. You cannot use OIDC as a placeholder for initialization
protocol.description_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化

saml.description_en: The SAML logon configuration. You can enter an XML file or manually enter the complete configuration. The query returns the standardized configuration and does not echo the original XML. This field can be omitted if it is not configured
saml.description_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. The query returns the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The entity ID of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be non-empty and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. You cannot change the entity ID of an existing configuration. This ID is different from the local entity ID returned by the SP query
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The SSO logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required when you manually enter the configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL and cannot contain user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: The list of IdP signing certificates. When you manually enter the configuration, this parameter is required and must be a non-empty array. Use PEM X.509 certificate text. The system verifies the current validity period. A maximum of two certificates are allowed after deduplication
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张

items.description_en: A valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example shows a public test certificate for idp.example.com. You must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP for actual integration
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

scimStatus.description_en: The independent SCIM status. This field does not change the meaning of shared resources and logon configuration in the original status field. It corresponds to the data.status field in the query operation
scimStatus.description_zh: 独立 SCIM 状态；不改变原 status 的共享资源及登录配置含义。与查询接口的 data.status 对应

status.description_en: The lifecycle status of the CustomSSO user pool and the task status of the logon configuration. This field does not indicate the SCIM operation result. You can query the SCIM switch result by using GetIdentityProviderSCIM.operationStatus. You cannot use this field to determine whether all protocols are configured
status.description_zh: CustomSSO 的用户池生命周期及登录配置任务状态，不表示 SCIM 操作结果。SCIM 开关结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM.operationStatus 查询；不能据此判断各协议均已配置
status.title_en: 共享资源及登录配置操作状态
status.title_zh: 共享资源及登录配置操作状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Do not set this parameter to true during CustomSSO initialization. You can only update this parameter later by calling UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM. Determine the result based on the operationStatus field
syncEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the record was last updated on the server
updatedAt.description_zh: 服务端记录的最近更新时间

workspaceId.description_en: Required. The ID of the destination workspace. The region of the request must be the same as the region of the destination workspace
workspaceId.description_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致

data.title_en: 原有绑定详情及新增 SCIM 状态
data.title_zh: 原有绑定详情及新增 SCIM 状态

httpStatusCode.description_en: The processing status of the current request. This status is not equivalent to the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: The message indicating that the request is accepted or an error message. For asynchronous tasks, verify the task result by calling the corresponding query operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use this ID to associate the current call with troubleshooting. Keep this ID if the call fails
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the current request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous writes, you must continue to query the task result
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
